decisive_items: Krebs von den Lungen-6 level: 1250 U/mL
response.rationale: The patient's history of chemotherapy, elevated KL-6, and diffuse ground-glass opacity on CT strongly indicate drug-induced interstitial lung disease, a specific form of drug-induced pneumonitis. BAL lymphocytic predominance further supports this.

rejected.why: Broader term; R6 is more specific and fits the interstitial pattern.
Organizing pneumonia not supported by BAL or other findings.
Negative anti-T. asahii antibodies and no organic dust exposure.
Cryptogenic organizing pneumonia is rare and not supported.
Lymphocytic BAL alone is insufficient; no interstitial pneumonia pattern.
